worker_environments.note: Artifacts without an `env` block predate per-worker environment capture and should be re-run before submission if their thread settings matter.

totals.note: Sum of per-experiment wall-clock. Jobs ran up to 5 at a time with OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, so this is CPU-time across workers, NOT elapsed time at the wall. Elapsed time is lower by roughly the concurrency factor.
